references.text: Command to follow exactly what the Lord has commanded, without turning to the right or to the left
Warning against turning from the Lord's word to the right or to the left
Joshua is told not to turn from the law to the right or to the left
Exhortation to hold fast to Moses' Book of the Law without turning to the right or to the left
Words of wisdom about not turning from the right path to the right or to the left
Command to do exactly as the Levitical priests teach concerning leprosy
The priests shall judge according to the Lord's statutes and laws
Jesus says that the scribes and Pharisees sit on Moses' seat, and the people should do what they say
Exhortation to obey their leaders and submit to them
